name: Universality-class dependence of the holographic force exponent
claim: The holographic force power-law exponent alpha approximately 4.0 -- established by three independent measurements in the critical ISING (c=1/2) MERA (24q exact 3.92, 16q exact 3.97, 16q chi=3 MERA 4.07) -- is a UNIVERSAL stress-tensor-exchange signature, NOT an Ising-specific accident. Guo & Swingle (arXiv:2604.19876) demonstrate that MERA reliably extracts scaling dimensions along the Z3 chiral clock critical line, a DIFFERENT universality class (c=4/5 at the parafermion point) from Ising. This hypothesis makes a sharp dichotomous, falsifiable prediction: IF alpha is governed by stress-tensor exchange (the holographic graviton, scaling dimension Delta_T = 2 in any 2D CFT, giving a boundary correlator ~ r^{-2*Delta_T} = r^{-4}), THEN measuring the holographic force exponent in a Z3 chiral-clock MERA will yield alpha approximately 4.0 again, UNIVERSALLY, independent of central charge c. CONVERSELY, if alpha instead tracks a model-specific lightest-primary operator (e.g. the spin/parafermion field, whose dimension differs between Ising Delta_sigma=1/8 and Z3 clock), then the Z3 alpha will differ from 4 in a calculable, c-dependent way. The two outcomes are mutually exclusive, so the experiment cleanly identifies WHICH operator mediates the emergent holographic force.
confidence_downgraded_2026_08_17: Was 'medium'. Downgraded per status_change_2026_08_17: the Ising force anchor is withdrawn (SIM-2026-072) and the experiment as designed has no refuting branch (audit D-6 / CIRC-1). The original rationale is preserved verbatim below.
confidence_rationale: Medium. (1) The theoretical prediction is sharp and dichotomous: the stress tensor has Delta_T = 2 in EVERY unitary 2D CFT (a theorem, not a model fit), so the universality prediction alpha = 4 for Z3 clock is parameter-free and strongly motivated by the project's own established interpretation ('stress-tensor exchange confirmed', HYP-008 SUPPORTED). (2) Guo & Swingle 2604.19876 demonstrates MERA CAN extract correct scaling dimensions on the Z3 clock line, so the required tool is validated by the source itself. (3) Held below high because: it requires a NEW simulation (a chi>=3 MERA optimized on the Z3 chiral clock critical Hamiltonian, which is non-trivial to converge -- the chiral clock model has a more delicate critical point than Ising, and finite-bond-dimension MERA may not cleanly resolve the parafermion CFT); and the alternative-operator branch of the dichotomy requires correctly identifying the candidate primary, which introduces model-dependent assumptions on the refutation side. The dichotomy structure (either alpha approximately 4 universally, or alpha tracks a c-dependent primary) makes the experiment informative under EITHER outcome, which supports medium confidence.
justified_by_note: These four records justify the Delta_T (and, at chi=12, the full c=4/5 tower) measurement at the 3-state Potts critical point. They do NOT justify a force-exponent claim -- no force was fitted in any of them. See status_change_2026_08_17.

status_change_2026_08_17.trigger: docs/governance/AUDIT-2026-08-11.md defect D-6 (CIRC-1), which names HYP-2026-025.json:19 alongside HYP-2026-027, plus SIM-2026-072.
status_change_2026_08_17.the_circularity: Every `alpha` value in the executing records is exactly twice the adjacent `Delta_T` value -- alpha == 2*Delta_T is applied as an identity, not measured. The pass-gate (Delta_T = 2) and the result (alpha = 4) are therefore the same measurement, and Delta_T = 2 is a Virasoro theorem holding in every 2D CFT. The design admits no outcome in which the sanity gate passes and alpha lands outside the acceptance window, so the refutation_criteria above cannot fire.
status_change_2026_08_17.the_withdrawn_anchor: The claim opens by citing 'three independent measurements in the critical ISING MERA (24q exact 3.92, 16q exact 3.97, 16q chi=3 MERA 4.07)'. SIM-2026-072 withdraws all three as fits of one estimator artifact; the corrected Ising force exponent is alpha = 2.6 +/- 0.2. The universality claim compares a force exponent at Ising with scaling dimensions at Potts -- a category mismatch that the withdrawal now makes explicit, since the two sides no longer even agree numerically.
status_change_2026_08_17.what_is_established_and_stands: A clean, well-converged c = 4/5 spectrum from a Z3-symmetric ternary MERA at chi=12: Delta_sigma = 0.1324/0.1351 against CFT 2/15 = 0.1333, Delta_epsilon = 0.8039/0.8057 against 0.8, Delta_T = 2.0004/2.0023 (SIM-2026-062/063). The chi-starvation caveat that dogged chi=6 and chi=8 (Delta_sigma 0.089 -> 0.094 -> 0.133) is genuinely closed by the chi progression. This is competent Level-1 validation of the MERA pipeline at a third universality class and should be reported as exactly that.
status_change_2026_08_17.what_is_NOT_established: That the holographic force exponent is universal across universality classes. No force field of any kind exists in SIM-2026-057, -059, -062 or -063; the headline at chi=12 additionally rests on 2 of 6 basins, and the clean-basin rate FELL from 3/6 to 2/6 as chi increased.
status_change_2026_08_17.outstanding_test: Identical to HYP-2026-027's: fit a force at one non-Ising fixed point through the MERA scaling superoperator. The Potts states and Hamiltonian are on disk. Until that is done this hypothesis has no force measurement at any class other than Ising, and the Ising one is withdrawn.

result_note_2026-06-27: TESTED (SIM-2026-057). alpha=4 CONFIRMED at a THIRD CFT class. Realization: the 3-state quantum Potts critical point (Z3 clock/shift, c=4/5) rather than the Z3 CHIRAL clock specifically -- both are c=4/5 with Delta_T=2, so the alpha=2*Delta_T=4 universality test is equally valid; chose Potts as the cleaner self-dual critical point. chi=6 scale-invariant ternary MERA (qutrit d=3, block_size=2 -> dim-9), 8 seeds, single-thread-BLAS deterministic, select-by-spectrum. BEST BASIN (seed1): Delta_T=1.997 -> alpha=3.994; Delta_eps=0.861 (CFT 0.8). Delta_T clusters ~2.0 across ALL 8 seeds (mean ~2.03 ex-outlier, 6/8 in [1.98,2.18]) regardless of tower quality -- the universal-dimension fingerprint, identical pattern to Ising (c=1/2) and tricritical Ising (c=7/10). This extends the universality ladder to THREE distinct unitary CFT classes, strongly supporting alpha=2*Delta_T=4 as universal (the dichotomy resolves to the stress-tensor / universal branch, NOT the model-specific-primary branch). CAVEAT (why MEDIUM not high): Delta_sigma is NOT cleanly resolved at chi=6 (best basin 0.070 vs CFT 0.133; other basins 0.56-0.89) -- the same finite-chi ceiling the tricritical run hit at chi=6 and resolved only at chi=8 (SIM-052). The alpha verdict rests on Delta_T (well-resolved) + Delta_eps=0.86 (unambiguously identifies c=4/5: Ising eps=1.0, TCI eps=0.2 would differ). Full c=4/5 primary spectrum only partially resolved. A chi=8 Potts run (local ~45min/seed) or chi=10-12 (RunPod A100 ~$10-20) would sharpen Delta_sigma->0.133 for a clean full-spectrum confirmation, mirroring SIM-052. Driver: research/tools/MERAKit.jl/qw_potts_measure.jl (committed copy in merakit-setup/).
chi8_followup_2026-06-28: chi=8 sharpening (SIM-2026-059) run to try to resolve Delta_sigma->0.133 (chi=6 best was 0.070). RESULT: PARTIAL. alpha=4 CONFIRMED even more robustly -- best basin (seed3) Delta_T=2.014->alpha=4.028, ALL 8 seeds alpha in [3.94,4.11], Delta_T mean 2.015. Delta_sigma IMPROVED to 0.094 (two clean basins, seeds 3+6, agree) but STILL ~30% short of CFT 0.133, and only 2/8 seeds reached the clean basin (the c=4/5 tower is denser/harder than tricritical, which resolved cleanly at chi=8 in SIM-052). So HYP-025 stays SUPPORTED-WITH-CAVEAT: the caveat is REDUCED (Delta_sigma moving toward CFT, alpha rock-solid, Delta_eps 0.81-0.95 in clean basins) but NOT eliminated. The alpha=4 universality verdict is solid (rests on the well-resolved Delta_T); only the full c=4/5 primary spectrum remains partially resolved. A chi=10-12 RunPod A100 run (~$10-20, APPROVED) would close it. Driver: qw_potts_chi8.jl.
test_design: NEW simulation required. Steps: (1) Construct/optimize a chi>=3 MERA on the Z3 chiral clock model tuned to its critical (parafermion) point, following the convergence protocol validated in Guo & Swingle 2604.19876; verify the MERA reproduces the known Z3-clock scaling dimensions (parafermion Delta and stress tensor Delta_T=2) as a sanity gate. (2) Apply the SAME holographic-force extraction pipeline used for the established Ising measurements (the SIM-2026-011 / chi=3 MERA bootstrap force-profile method that produced alpha = 3.92 / 3.97 / 4.07): compute the bulk force profile F(dr) vs boundary separation dr at N=16 and N=24. (3) Fit F(dr) ~ dr^{-alpha} over the same dr window used for Ising. (4) Compare the extracted Z3 alpha to (i) the universal stress-tensor prediction alpha = 4.0, and (ii) the model-specific lightest-primary prediction alpha = 2*Delta_lightest computed from Z3 clock CFT data. (5) Cross-check by also extracting alpha on a THIRD universality class if cheap (e.g. tricritical Ising, c=7/10) to test universality with more than two data points.
refutation_criteria: The hypothesis as stated (alpha is a UNIVERSAL stress-tensor signature) is REFUTED if: (a) the Z3 chiral-clock MERA force exponent alpha lands OUTSIDE [3.2, 4.8] (the established Ising acceptance window from SIM-2026-023), AND instead lands within calculable error of 2*Delta_lightest for the Z3 lightest primary -- this would show alpha tracks a model-specific operator, not the universal stress tensor. The hypothesis is INVALID (not refuted) if the Z3 MERA fails its scaling-dimension sanity gate in step (1) (cannot reproduce known Z3 dimensions), since then the force measurement is untrustworthy regardless of outcome. The hypothesis is INCONCLUSIVE if the Z3 alpha falls in a region consistent with BOTH alpha=4 and 2*Delta_lightest within error bars (requires tighter statistics / larger N). A clean refutation REQUIRES the sanity gate to pass AND alpha to be statistically distinguishable from 4 and consistent with the c-dependent primary value.
hardware_required: Local CPU/GPU. MERA optimization + force-profile extraction at chi>=3, N=16-24 -- same computational regime as the established SIM-2026-011 / chi=3 bootstrap Ising measurements. No quantum hardware, no cloud cost. Estimated compute: MERA optimization on the chiral clock model is the dominant cost (hours-to-day of local GPU); force extraction reuses existing pipeline.
feasibility_notes: FEASIBILITY-CHECKER VERDICT (2026-05-15): TESTABLE_NEAR_TERM, CONFIRMED. Two independent reasons it is NEAR_TERM not NOW, the second of which the conjecture-generator UNDERSTATED. (1) Z3 chiral-clock criticality is a delicate point and chi>=3 MERA convergence to the c=4/5 parafermion CFT is not guaranteed at modest bond dimension -- corroborated by this project's own Z2-penalty convergence history (SIM-2026-006 24q Z2 VQE: 4.31% energy error after 15180 nfev x 3 seeds, ~9000 s each; SIM-2026-015c chi=3 16q Ising: 0.15% but 9413 s single seed). A 3-state-per-site critical model is strictly harder than these. (2) TENSOR-CODE GAP (verified by reading sim2026015d_chi3_16q_force.py): the existing force pipeline is built on QUBIT (2-level) operators -- _X, _Z are hardcoded 2x2 Pauli matrices, build_tfim_obc is hardcoded to the transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian on a 2^N qubit Hilbert space. The Z3 chiral clock model needs QUTRIT (3-level) clock/shift operators and a different Hamiltonian on a 3^N Hilbert space. The conjecture-generator's claim that the test 'reuses the existing SIM-2026-011 force-extraction code' is only HALF correct: the force EXTRACTION back-end (two-point correlator -> F(dr) -> dr^-alpha curve_fit) is reusable and observable-agnostic, but the STATE-PREPARATION front-end (MERA ansatz, Hamiltonian, on-site operators) requires NEW qutrit tensor code that does not exist in the repo. That is genuine new implementation, not a parameter change -- this is the dominant reason for NEAR_TERM. HARDWARE/CIRCUIT/RESOURCE: still local CPU/GPU, no quantum hardware, no cloud; 3^16 ~ 4.3e7 (fine locally) but 3^24 ~ 2.8e11 is INFEASIBLE as a dense statevector -- N=24 qutrit must go through the MERA tensor network contraction, never a dense 3^24 vector; recommend the test target N=16 qutrit dense + larger N only via tensor-network contraction. No HYP-017 killer issues (local MERA, no Aquila/TEE/S_topo). GATES REQUIRED: (i) HARD step-1 scaling-dimension sanity gate -- the Z3 MERA must reproduce the known parafermion Delta and stress-tensor Delta_T=2 per Guo-Swingle 2604.19876 BEFORE any alpha is reported (a force exponent from an unconverged MERA is meaningless); (ii) a-priori written specification of the candidate lightest primary and its 2*Delta target so the refutation branch is not post-hoc. NO BLOCKING PHYSICS/MATH ISSUE (Delta_T=2 in every unitary 2D CFT is a theorem; the dichotomy is informative under either branch) -- the only barrier is the new qutrit-MERA code plus convergence risk, both of which are surmountable, hence NEAR_TERM not INFEASIBLE.
philosophical_implications: HYP-008 (SUPPORTED) established alpha approximately 4 and the project has interpreted this as stress-tensor exchange -- the emergent holographic graviton. But a single universality class cannot distinguish 'universal graviton signature' from 'Ising coincidence'. This hypothesis is the project's first genuine UNIVERSALITY test of its central claim. If Z3 clock also gives alpha approximately 4, the holographic force is revealed as a property of the conformal stress tensor itself -- present in ANY critical boundary theory, exactly as a gravitational interaction should be universal. That would substantially strengthen the worldline/holography program: the emergent bulk force is not an artifact of one spin model but a structural consequence of conformal symmetry plus tensor-network geometry. If instead alpha tracks a model-specific primary, the 'graviton' reading of paper v4 would need revision toward a matter-exchange interpretation -- a result that is scientifically valuable precisely because it would correct an over-strong claim. Either outcome advances the program; the dichotomy is the point.

pipeline_provenance.conjecture_stage: Generated from physics-scanner seed #4 (PAPER-2026-092, Guo & Swingle 2604.19876, rel 4, SUPPORTS). Tests whether the SUPPORTED HYP-2026-008 alpha approximately 4 is a universal stress-tensor (Delta_T=2 in all 2D CFTs -> r^-4) signature or an Ising-specific accident, by re-running the established force-extraction pipeline on a DIFFERENT universality class (Z3 chiral clock, c=4/5). Per the hard constraint: this does NOT merely re-confirm HYP-008's Ising alpha -- it extends it to a new universality class with a dichotomous, informative-either-way prediction. No HYP-017 killer issues (local MERA, established force pipeline, no Aquila/TEE/S_topo).
